captions.detailed: This 3D model is a stylized, posable humanoid figure composed of geometric primitives. It features a rectangular blocky torso with a wider shoulder section, a spherical head on a cylindrical neck, and segmented limbs with spherical joints representing knees, elbows, and ankles. The legs are modeled with tapered cylinders and end in small rectangular block feet, while the arms are bent forward in a dynamic, defensive or athletic pose.
captions.instruction: Design a highly customizable, posable humanoid figure in OpenSCAD. The model should have adjustable parameters for the torso (height, width, thickness), head (radius, neck length), arms, and legs (lengths, segment ratios, and joint angles for dynamic posing).
captions.factory: The design is structured into modular components: draw_torso, draw_head, draw_arms, and draw_legs. The torso is built using cube primitives for the main body and shoulders. The head, knees, elbows, and ankles use sphere primitives, while the neck and limb segments are generated with cylinder primitives. Complex trigonometric formulas calculate the precise x, y, z translation offsets of joint spheres and limb segments based on user-defined rotation angles (such as knee bend, arm out, and front angles), allowing the figure to maintain proper connectivity regardless of the pose.
